黙る.note: だまる: る = the monk's RULE of silence → to be silent. だます: す = SWINDLE → to trick.

騙す.note: だます: す = SWINDLE → to trick. だまる: る = the monk's RULE of silence → to be silent.

叫ぶ.note: さけぶ: ぶ = "BOO!" → to shout. さける: dodging the SACKER → to avoid.

避ける.note: さける: dodging the SACKER → to avoid. さけぶ: ぶ = "BOO!" → to shout.

悲しい.note: かなしい: a can with "nashi" (no pear) → sad. かなり: the loud CANARY → considerably.

かなり.note: かなり: the loud CANARY → considerably, quite. かなしい: a can with "nashi" → sad.

三日.note: みっか: か = the day the MITTENS dry → three days / the 3rd. みっつ: MEAT-SUshi → three things.

三つ.note: みっつ: MEAT-SUshi → three things. みっか: か = the day the MITTENS dry → three days / the 3rd.

肩.note: かた: a KARATE chop to the shoulder → shoulder. かたい: the CAT's EYE on a frozen fish → hard.

硬い.note: かたい: the CAT's EYE (い) on a frozen fish → hard. かた: a KARATE chop → shoulder.

丈夫.note: じょうぶ: the Joker's BOOKworm (ぶ) → sturdy. じょうず: the Joker JUggles (ず) → skillful. じょうし: the Joker bosses the SHeep (し) → your boss.

上手.note: じょうず: the Joker JUggles (ず) → skillful. じょうぶ: the Joker's BOOKworm (ぶ) → sturdy. じょうし: the Joker bosses the SHeep (し) → your boss.

上司.note: じょうし: the Joker bosses the SHeep (し) → your boss. じょうぶ: the Joker's BOOKworm (ぶ) → sturdy. じょうず: the Joker JUggles (ず) → skillful.

感謝.note: かんしゃ: the clean shark bows → thanks. かんじゃ: the MUDDY shark (゛ = mud: しゃ→じゃ) waits at the clinic → patient. 患 has 心: a heart that suffers.

患者.note: かんじゃ: the MUDDY shark (゛ = mud: しゃ→じゃ) at the clinic → patient. かんしゃ: the clean shark bows → thanks.

性格.note: Same sound せいかく. 性格 has 忄 (heart) → your character. 正確 has 正 (correct) → accurate.

正確.note: Same sound せいかく. 正確 starts with 正 (correct) → accurate. 性格 has 忄 (heart) → personality.

起こる.note: Same sound おこる. 起こる has 走 (run): things start running → to happen. 怒る has 心 (heart) → to get angry.

怒る.note: Same sound おこる. 怒る has 心 (heart) → to get angry. 起こる has 走 (run) → to happen.

起こす.note: おこす wakes or causes something; おこる just happens. る = it happens by itself; す = someone does it to something.

残る.note: 残る = to remain (る: by itself); 残す = to leave behind (す: you do it). る = it happens by itself; す = someone does it to something.

残す.note: 残す = to leave behind (す: you do it); 残る = to remain (る: by itself). る = it happens by itself; す = someone does it to something.

渡る.note: 渡る = to cross (る: by itself); 渡す = to hand over (す: you do it). る = it happens by itself; す = someone does it to something.

渡す.note: 渡す = to hand over (す: you do it); 渡る = to cross (る: by itself). る = it happens by itself; す = someone does it to something.

通る.note: 通る = to pass (る: by itself); 通す = to let pass (す: you do it). る = it happens by itself; す = someone does it to something.

通す.note: 通す = to let pass (す: you do it); 通る = to pass (る: by itself). る = it happens by itself; す = someone does it to something.

治る.note: なおる: the body gets well by itself (る). なおす: you fix a thing (す). 治 has water: healing; 直 = straight: set it right. る = it happens by itself; す = someone does it to something.

直す.note: なおす: you fix or correct a thing (す). なおる: you get well by yourself (る). 直 = straight: set it right; 治 has water: healing.

帰る.note: かえる: YOU go home (帰 has the broom of home). かえす: you return a THING (返 = turn back). る = it happens by itself; す = someone does it to something.

返す.note: かえす: you give a thing back (返 = turn back). かえる: you yourself go home (帰).

興奮.note: こうふん: the Coach finds a FUNgus (ん) → excitement. こうふく: the Coach dances with captain HOOK (く) → happiness.

幸福.note: こうふく: the Coach dances with captain HOOK (く) → happiness. こうふん: the Coach finds a FUNgus (ん) → excitement.

遂に.note: ついに: TWEEty finally lands → at last. つねに: the cat at the same window every hour → always (常 = usual).

常に.note: つねに: same window, every hour → always (常 = usual). ついに: TWEEty finally lands → at last.

異なる.note: ことなる: every coat in NARnia (なる) → to differ. ことわる: the cat pushes the bowl aWAY (わる) → to refuse.

断る.note: ことわる: the cat pushes the bowl aWAY (わる) → to refuse. ことなる: every coat in NARnia (なる) → to differ.

思う.note: おもう (verb, う) → to think. おもい (adjective, い) → heavy. 重 is the anvil; 思 has 心 (heart).

重い.note: おもい (adjective, い) → heavy: the anvil 重. おもう (verb) → to think: 思 has 心 (heart).

結構.note: けっこう: KETchup on your coat (small っ) → fine / no thanks. けんこう: KEN doll jogs (ん) → health.

健康.note: けんこう: KEN doll jogs (ん) → health. けっこう: KETchup on your coat (small っ) → fine / no thanks.

財布.note: さいふ: the CYclops steals it → wallet. せいふ: the SAIlor and the Footballer run the country → government.

政府.note: せいふ: the SAIlor and the Footballer → government. さいふ: the CYclops steals the wallet.

尊敬.note: そんけい: Sonic bows to a CAKE (けい) → respect. そんざい: Sonic taps a XYlophone (ざい) → existence.

存在.note: そんざい: Sonic taps a XYlophone (ざい) → existence. そんけい: Sonic bows to a CAKE (けい) → respect.

掴む.note: つかむ: TWO CAMeras (む) → to grab. つかう: the raccoon tries each tool (う) → to use.

使う.note: つかう: the raccoon tries each tool → to use. つかむ: TWO CAMeras at once (む) → to grab.

始める.note: はじめる (verb): 始 has 女+台, the conductor starts → to begin. はじめて (adverb, て): 初 = clothes + knife, the first cut → for the first time.

初めて.note: はじめて: 初 = clothes 衤 + knife 刀, the first cut → for the first time. はじめる (verb): 始 → to begin something.

泣く.note: Same sound なく. 泣く has 氵 (water: tears) → a person cries. 鳴く has 鳥 (bird) / 口 → an animal cries, a bird sings.

鳴く.note: Same sound なく. 鳴く has 口 + 鳥 (bird) → an animal's cry, birdsong. 泣く has 氵 (tears) → a person cries.

暑い.note: Same sound あつい. 暑い has 日 (sun) → hot weather. 熱い has 灬 (fire) → hot to the touch (tea, a stove).

熱い.note: Same sound あつい. 熱い has 灬 (fire) → hot to the touch. 暑い has 日 (sun) → hot weather.

撮る.note: Same sound とる. 撮る → take a photo or film only. 取る → take in general (pick up, get, take away).

取る.note: Same sound とる. 取る → take in general. For photos it's 撮る (写真を撮る).

沸く.note: Same sound わく. 沸く has 氵 + 弗 → water boils (お湯が沸く). 湧く → springs up, wells up (water from the ground, feelings).

湧く.note: Same sound わく. 湧く → wells up (a spring, courage). 沸く → water boils (お湯が沸く).

嵐.note: あらし is a noun: the STORM itself. Its kanji is 山 mountain over 風 wind, a wind howling off the mountain ('Ara! She's gone!'). はげしい is an い-adjective: how strong anything is (激しい雨, 激しい痛み, 激しい競争), the bald coach's intense yelling.

激しい.note: はげしい is an い-adjective (it ends in しい): how strong anything is, rain, pain, competition, like the bald coach's intense yelling. あらし is a noun: the STORM itself, 山 mountain over 風 wind ('Ara! She's gone!').
